<!-- A proposal to improve the SAAF quality standards (docs/conventions/quality-standards.md, agent-template).
     Proposals are not merged on the day. The organisers review all of them afterwards and fold the best into the
     next version of the standards. Keep it short: a proposal that makes the standards simpler scores higher. -->

## Type
<!-- Tick one: put an x between the brackets. -->
- [ ] Change to an existing standard
- [ ] New standard
- [ ] Removing or merging a standard

## Standard
<!-- Which of the nine (README, agent.yaml, AUDIT-CRITERIA.md, SECURITY.md, LICENSE, tests, dependencies, CI, CODEOWNERS), or "new". -->

## The problem, with evidence
<!-- What goes wrong today? Name a real repo and file, an issue or pull request, or a finding from your own Session 10 list. A link helps; a clear reference is enough. One case is a start; two are better. -->

## The change
<!-- What changes, in one or two sentences. The diff shows the rest. -->

## How it is checked
<!-- A rule the board can check without a person (a file or content check), or the question a reviewer asks. It must take under a minute. -->

## What it costs a team
<!-- Minutes per repo, once and per quarter. -->

## What it replaces or removes
<!-- What gets simpler or goes away. For a new standard: which standard it replaces or merges with (one in, one out keeps it at nine). -->

## Only for a new standard
<!-- Delete this section for a change to an existing standard. -->
- Why it does not fit inside one of the nine:
- Evidence from at least two repos or findings:
- How the review agent scores it from 0 to 3:
